plan.name: Give verify checks enough time
plan.summary: For Invariant's built-in plumbing checks, selecting the exact internal/verify package, including through its embedded assets or acceptance tests, gives the shared touched-test phase twenty minutes inside a twenty-five-minute run; checks selecting only other packages keep ten minutes inside twelve, and repository-contract checks retain their existing limits. Apply the selected limits consistently to direct and queued checks, the agent's test tool and fresh final checks, with preparation charged from entry or queue admission, shorter overrides and parent cancellation preserved, no renewal between tests, and unfinished tests retained in timeout reports. Give direct builds touching internal/verify enough tool time for the longer check and its existing startup and cleanup reserves, preserve queued builds' tool allowances, and keep execution and queue waits charged to the build's existing shared time allowance. Update SPEC.md and docs/factory.md to describe the exception and the unchanged defaults, citing D-0281, D-0296, D-0303, D-0173, D-0122 and D-0294 as applicable, and update the opt-in real-image capacity test and its documented invocation for the longer verify-check budget while retaining its concurrency, resource and partial-result assertions. The merger must record the new decision extending D-0281's limits for internal/verify; this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestVerifyCheckSelectsLongerBudgetsPrecisely
tests.says: Only checks selecting internal/verify receive twenty minutes for tests and twenty-five minutes overall, including asset and acceptance-test ownership; other packages retain their limits, and overrides or parent deadlines can only shorten the selected budgets.

tests.name: TestVerifyCheckAllowsElevenMinutes
tests.says: The actual runner completes an eleven-minute equivalent test under the verify budget, with real test evidence, using proportionally shortened time in the fixture.

tests.name: TestVerifyCheckCutsOffTwentyOneMinutesWithNames
tests.says: The actual runner cuts off twenty-one-minute equivalent tests at the twenty-minute shared budget and reports every running or unstarted test by package and name.

tests.name: TestVerifyBuildSharesBudgetsWithoutRenewingExecutionTime
tests.says: The agent's test call and the final check select the same longer budgets, direct and queued tool timers accommodate them, ordinary direct builds retain their default timer, and an active verify check still ends when the build's own execution allowance expires.
